owner_authored_final.description: Published or otherwise author-final Marie Satori writing. Voice evidence only; historical facts are never runtime facts.

exact_owner_approved.description: Exact wording explicitly approved by the owner. Positive writer use still depends on the approval scope; calibration-only approval is not generation authorization.

owner_revised_candidate.description: Owner-written or owner-directed revision that has not received exact full-unit approval. Contextual and contrastive evidence only.

positive_direction_not_approved.description: Positive feedback such as preferred direction or 'this is better.' Never exact approval.

ai_candidate_unreviewed.description: AI-authored candidate awaiting owner review. It may be audited or contrasted but never retrieved as positive voice evidence.

owner_rejected.description: Wording explicitly rejected or replaced by the owner. Negative and contrastive evidence.

historical_only.description: Preserved for provenance but incompatible with the active surface contract or evaluation state.

third_party_source.description: CC, SD, AC, or other outside material. Knowledge or individual-word reference only; never Marie Satori voice evidence.

hardRules: Only owner_authored_final and in-scope exact_owner_approved records may set useAsPositiveVoiceEvidence true.
Calibration-only approval never authorizes writer or generation evidence.
A judge score never changes an authority class.
Positive feedback never becomes exact approval.
Historical dates and numerical claims in voice excerpts never become runtime facts.
Third-party phrasing, cadence, metaphors, and signature constructions are never positive Marie Satori voice evidence.
